workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:

- Thu 14:30-15:30 (E&D free): Marcus is busy (Dentist appointment 14:30-15:00)

Our overlapping slots (Priya & Marcus): Mon 09:00-10:00, Tue 13:00-14:00, Wed 15:00-16:00, Thu 10:00-10:30, Fri 11:00-12:00 - none of these work for Elena & David.

I've verified this carefully. There is no 30-minute slot where all four partners are free. I'll report this as infeasible.
